affectedPublicSurfaces: NO HTTP SURFACE CHANGES, PLAINLY. No route is added, removed or altered, and NO ROUTE SHAPE CHANGES. What changes is that a suspended Clear Excess run can now END `seller_modified` with its own message — a new terminal value on an existing field, not a new field and not a new endpoint. This is a comparison, a terminal cause and a suppression; nothing else on the wire moves.

A NEW TERMINAL CAUSE ON AN EXISTING WIRE FIELD. Verified 2026-09-08: `StopReason` (`services/agent/status.py:100-158`) holds sixteen members and `seller_modified` is NOT among them (zero hits in `backend/src` or `packages/`); it fits the `String(32)` budget. It must be DISTINCT from `goal_met` and from both expiry causes — a client counting end states will see a value it has never seen, and the whole point of naming it is that the eight causes stay countable separately (S-NFR-7).

SUPPRESSION OF FUTURE CARDS FOR ONE ACTIVITY — a seller-visible ABSENCE, and the part of this slice with the longest tail. After a run ends `seller_modified`, NO FUTURE CARD IS EMITTED FOR THAT ACTIVITY: a new card needs a new basis. A suppression rule that is too broad silently mutes a shop's Clear Excess feed forever; too narrow and Juli re-proposes managing a thing the seller has taken back. State the exact key the suppression is recorded against in the PR.

SELLER-FACING COPY THAT MUST STATE ITS OWN LATENCY. The message says the seller changed the promotion, that Juli stopped managing it, and that IT STAYS AS THEY SET IT. It must ALSO state plainly that a LIST-PRICE edit is caught only on the next reconcile — implying an instant catch is a promise the mechanism cannot keep. Vietnamese, second person, through the seller-copy sanitiser, no internal identifier (S-NFR-4).

WEBHOOK #63 IS CONSUMED HERE BUT ADDED ELSEWHERE. Verified 2026-09-08: `services/tiktok/webhook_catalog.py` carries nineteen ids — 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 21, 24, 27, 37, 39, 58, 64, 65, 67, 68 — and #63 IS ABSENT, with no occurrence of the string anywhere in the file. #1708's dispatcher work adds it; THIS slice consumes it. If #63 is still absent when implementation starts, that is a blocked dependency, not a catalog entry to add here.

THE CREATION SNAPSHOT IS THE COMPARISON BASIS, AND IT IS NOT A RE-DERIVATION. At create time the run snapshots the activity EXACTLY AS JULI MADE IT — depth or price, the product set, and the window. Divergence is measured against THAT, never against what the rule would compute today; a re-derived basis would drift with configuration and turn a benign config change into a fleet-wide false intervention.

migrationCompatibility.notes: NO SCHEMA CHANGE. This slice adds NO new run state and NO new tool: it is a comparison, a terminal cause and a suppression. The `seller_modified` stop reason must already be inside the widened `ck_workflow_runs_stop_reason` CHECK — verified 2026-09-08 that `StopReason` (`services/agent/status.py:100-158`) holds sixteen members and does NOT contain it, so it arrives with #1707's stop-reason work; it is 15 characters, inside the `String(32)` budget. CHECK BEFORE WRITING CODE that #1707 landed it in BOTH the model's `__table_args__` and a migration; if it did not, STOP AND REPORT rather than widening the CHECK here, because widening it in this slice would put the enum and the constraint in two different commits and the parity test would find the drift after the fact. The CREATION SNAPSHOT and the ACTIVITY ID the guard compares against are persisted upstream (#1815/#1816); if implementation finds neither is durable, that is a blocked dependency to report, not a column to add — and IF ANY ADDITIVE COLUMN IS NEEDED for the snapshot or for the per-activity card suppression, ITS NUMBER IS RESERVED BY META and supplied with the issue, nullable, with no backfill and no NOT NULL. NEVER run `alembic heads`, never read the tip of `backend/src/juli_backend/database/migrations/versions/`, never derive the number from the newest filename. The chain's single head today is `055_juli_app_sync_state_update`, but W6, W8, W9 and the sibling W10 lanes hold unlanded numbers off-tree and this tree already carries two duplicate-numbered pairs (`003_*`, `043_*`) from exactly this mistake.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. A suspended Clear Excess run keeps managing an activity the seller has already edited or deactivated, and a restock does not end the run — which is the failure mode a thirty-day wait invents, left open. #1818 stays blocked on the end-state vocabulary this slice completes a member of. Nothing is exposed, nothing is partially applied, no data hazard: the guard writes nothing even when it works, so its absence writes nothing either.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: DRAIN OR REAP EVERY RUN IN `waiting_external` FIRST. A rollback that removes the resume path strands a suspended run: the previous code does not recognise the state, its reaper judges only `(QUEUED, RUNNING)` and `(WAITING_APPROVAL,)` (`reaper.py:400,441`), so the run will neither resume nor be reaped while the live TikTok discount behind it keeps running. Enumerate them, close them deliberately, and deactivate their activities by hand where the seller has already taken the promotion back. Then redeploy the previous release and restart juli-api, juli-celery-worker and juli-celery-beat. NO DOWNGRADE IS NEEDED: there is no migration in this slice, and runs already ended `seller_modified` STAY ENDED — nothing was written on their behalf, so there is no vendor state to undo and no compensating action to take. THE CONSEQUENCE TO STATE IN THE PR: the revert removes the guard, so the fleet returns to a suspended run that keeps managing an activity the seller has taken back; and the per-activity card suppression goes with it, so a `seller_modified` activity becomes re-cardable — decide before rolling back whether that is acceptable for the shops affected.

doNotInfer: Do NOT write a Clear-Excess-local copy of the guard. Use THE SHARED guard from #1715, asserted by identity — a private copy is exactly what ADR-091 d.5 forbids, and no test in this lane would catch it.

Do NOT catch a DOWNWARD stock move here. A decrease at or below the goal is #1816's goal path; catching it in the guard makes that path unreachable, and only a test that asserts BOTH branches on one signal shape can see the mistake.

Do NOT revert, re-issue or write anything when the guard fires. JULI CHANGES NOTHING — no revert, no re-issue, no compensating write. Reconciling Juli's intent onto the seller's edit is the option ADR-091 d.5 explicitly rejected: it overwrites a deliberate human act with a stale plan. The seller's edit always wins.

Do NOT compare against a re-derivation. The basis is the CREATION SNAPSHOT — depth or price, product set, window, exactly as Juli made it. A basis recomputed from current configuration drifts, and a benign config change becomes a fleet-wide false intervention.
Do NOT let Juli's own deactivation trip the guard. The run must distinguish its own act from the seller's, or #1816's goal path ends `seller_modified` every time it succeeds.

Do NOT add webhook #63 to the catalog here. Verified 2026-09-08 it is ABSENT (`services/tiktok/webhook_catalog.py` carries 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 21, 24, 27, 37, 39, 58, 64, 65, 67, 68 and no 63); #1708 adds it and THIS SLICE CONSUMES IT. If it is still absent, the slice is blocked — stop and report.

Do NOT drive the guard from a hand-built divergence flag. It runs from REAL persisted `workflow_webhook_signals` rows and a REAL re-read of the activity; a test that sets `diverged = True` is testing its own fixture.
Do NOT imply an instant catch for a list-price edit. It is caught only on the NEXT RECONCILE, and the copy must state that latency plainly rather than promising something the mechanism cannot do.

Do NOT suppress cards too broadly. The suppression is per ACTIVITY — a new card needs a new basis — and must not mute a different activity in the same shop; state the exact key it is recorded against in the PR.
Do NOT add a new run state or a new tool. This slice is a comparison, a terminal cause and a suppression; `WorkflowRunStatus` must still hold exactly the members #1706 gave it.

Do NOT widen the stop-reason CHECK here. `seller_modified` arrives with #1707; verified 2026-09-08 it does not exist in `StopReason` (`services/agent/status.py:100-158`). If #1707 did not land it in BOTH the model and a migration, stop and report — widening it here splits the enum and the constraint across commits.
Do NOT add a second reaper policy object. The reaper resolves per run through #1702's registry via the existing `policy=` seam; this slice touches no timer.
Do NOT ask for a fresh CONFIRM. The guard ends a run; it never proposes anything, and the one act exempt from a fresh CONFIRM (the goal-triggered deactivation) is #1816's, not this slice's.
Do NOT infer a flash sale, a markdown, a base-price write or a stock write. When the guard fires, no write of any kind is issued; S-FR-6 forbids the rest outright.
Do NOT let a model decide whether the seller intervened. It is a deterministic comparison against a snapshot (S-FR-4).

Do NOT change the card's KPI tie. `KPI_WORKFLOW_KEYS` maps `clear_excess_4` to `inventory_turnover` and `dsi` (`services/scoring/kpi_catalog.py:46-47`) while ADR-055 d.15 says AOV; CE-NFR-3 leaves both alone and the tie stays whatever the surface renders today.
Do NOT read revenue. v1 records facts only; the revenue reading on cleared SKUs is deferred to v2.

Do NOT reach for `Search Activities`. It DOES NOT EXIST at TikTok (resolved 2026-09-05 — `contract-collection.md` A-25, `endpoints.md:509`); the re-read is Get Activity on the id Juli persisted, and nothing else.
Do NOT assert tenant isolation as the table owner. The runtime role is `juli_app` (`043_juli_app_role.py`, ADR-085) and RLS only binds for it.
Do NOT open the TikTok corpora catalogs (ADR-051); do NOT touch apps/**, packages/** or ios/** — this epic's doNotLoad list.

Bind every test collaborator to the REAL object — the real signal row, the real activity re-read, the real shared guard, the real card producer. A `**kwargs` double proves routing, never that the real call would work.
